optimized_sql:
SELECT item.i_item_id, item.i_item_desc, store.s_store_id, store.s_store_name,
       MAX(base.max_ss_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       MAX(base.max_sr_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       MAX(cs_agg.max_cs_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM (
    SELECT store_sales.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           store_sales.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           store_sales.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
           MAX(store_sales.ss_net_profit) AS max_ss_profit,
           MAX(store_returns.sr_net_loss) AS max_sr_loss
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN store_returns
      ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = store_returns.sr_customer_sk
     AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk
     AND store_sales.ss_ticket_number = store_returns.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN date_dim AS d1
      ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
     AND d1.d_moy = 4
     AND d1.d_year = 1999
    JOIN date_dim AS d2
      ON store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
     AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
     AND d2.d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY store_sales.ss_customer_sk, store_sales.ss_item_sk, store_sales.ss_store_sk
) AS base
JOIN (
    SELECT catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           catalog_sales.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
           MAX(catalog_sales.cs_net_profit) AS max_cs_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim AS d3
      ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
     AND d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
     AND d3.d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, catalog_sales.cs_item_sk
) AS cs_agg
  ON cs_agg.customer_sk = base.customer_sk
 AND cs_agg.item_sk = base.item_sk
JOIN store
  ON store.s_store_sk = base.store_sk
JOIN item
  ON item.i_item_sk = base.item_sk
GROUP BY item.i_item_id, item.i_item_desc, store.s_store_id, store.s_store_name
ORDER BY item.i_item_id, item.i_item_desc, store.s_store_id, store.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
